articles.title_en: Russian Armed Forces snipers destroyed 100 Ukrainian Armed Forces drones

articles.title_en: Ministry of Internal Affairs: fraud couriers help solve crimes they themselves committed
articles.lead_en: The courier is a full-fledged participant in the criminal process, he is subject to liability under articles of fraud or theft, noted Vladimir Vasenin, head of the press service of the capital’s Main Directorate of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia.

articles.title_en: "Tochka Bank": Russian companies began to use national currencies more often in payments
articles.lead_en: The dollar and euro have been replaced by the ruble, yuan, Turkish lira and Kazakh tenge, said Sergey Noritsin, director of work with financial institutions at Tochka Bank.

articles.title_en: Expert Lyashok: about 28% of married couples in the Russian Federation retire almost simultaneously
articles.lead_en: In 49.3% of cases, the gap between the moments when a husband and wife left the labor market does not exceed three years, added a leading researcher at the Institute of Social Analysis and Forecasting of the Presidential Academy

articles.title_en: ONF: the volume of issued car loans in the Russian Federation in the first quarter increased by 20%
